pmc-11512363.description: Simple SummaryUtilizing food industry by-products for animal feed is challenging due to their low nutrient content. Fermentation reduced fiber, increased protein by 21.89%, and improved amino acid ratios.

pmc-12629730.title: Intravascular Brachytherapy for In-Stent Restenosis in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease
pmc-12629730.creator: Gal Sella, Chloe Kharsa, Mangesh Kritya, Devin Olek, Bin S. Teh, Muhammad Faraz Anwaar, Joseph Elias, Elia El Hajj, Albert E. Raizner, Andrew Farach, Neal S. Kleiman, Alpesh Shah
pmc-12629730.description: BackgroundIn-stent restenosis (ISR) remains a significant challenge in coronary intervention, particularly among patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) who exhibit altered inflammatory responses and accelerated vascular calcification. Vascular brachytherapy has reemerged as a potential treatment modality for recurrent ISR. This study evaluates the clinical outcomes of vascular brachytherapy for ISR in patients with and without CKD.

pmc-12932339.title: Differences in clinical course between pituitary apoplexy and non-apoplexy patients with nonfunctioning pituitary neuroendocrine tumors

pmc-12932339.description: Although the imaging diagnosis of pituitary apoplexy has been well reported, research on the clinical symptoms of this condition remains scarce. This retrospective study used data from 311 patients with nonfunctioning pituitary neuroendocrine tumors treated with initial transsphenoidal surgery.
